claim: The Heritage Foundation — the Washington policy institute that coordinated Project 2025's "Mandate for Leadership" — has been chaired since September 25, 2018 by Barb Van Andel-Gaby, a member of the family that co-founded Amway and a director of Alticor, Amway's parent company. She joined the Heritage board in 1996 and was elected vice chairman in 2014. Heritage announced the installation itself, and its then-president described the family's role in the terms the institute uses about itself: "Barb and her entire family have had a generational impact on policy and countless lives through their prosperous businesses and their generosity."

sources.label: The Heritage Foundation press release, "Barb Van Andel-Gaby Becomes Chairman of Heritage Foundation Board of Trustees," September 25, 2018
sources.quote: Van Andel-Gaby joined the Heritage Board of Trustees in 1996, and was elected vice chairman of the board in 2014.

sources.label: Same release — Alticor/Amway directorship and prior Amway Hotel Corp. and Peter Island Resorts roles
sources.quote: In addition to her service at Heritage, Van Andel-Gaby is a member of the board of directors of Alticor, the parent company of Amway.

notes: Quotes read from the Internet Archive snapshot of the release (web.archive.org/web/20260413083547) after the live page refused a scripted fetch; the live page renders in a browser and the clips were taken from it. Records governance only — who chairs the board, and since when. Reported figures on DeVos and Van Andel foundation grants to Heritage (a $30,000 Steve & Cindy Van Andel Foundation total 2009-11; seven-figure DeVos grants) come from secondary trackers and are not carried here until the underlying Form 990s are pulled.
